notes: A finish_reason outside OpenAI's five values raises a pydantic ValidationError (ChatCompletion.model_validate), so the response is lost. Also reproduced on 1.33.3. The same error reaches provider='openai' pointed at Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (ollama-openai).

Existing upstream issue, not opened by wiretruth. Ollama sends an id on each tool call, but the ollama Python client (0.6.3, latest) has no field for it, so any-llm's native provider generates UUIDs instead (providers/ollama/utils.py).

any-llm documents the fallback: a done_reason outside stop, length, tool_calls, content_filter and function_call is reported as stop (https://github.com/mozilla-ai/any-llm/blob/18ed82b8ae89db560bf0b1ec8bccb752fc0e2b5d/src/any_llm/providers/ollama/utils.py#L33-L46). The caller cannot tell an unfamiliar reason from a normal stop.

Existing upstream issue, not opened by wiretruth. Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint ignores max_completion_tokens (v0.40.3), and any-llm's openai provider sends only that name (providers/openai/base.py), so the limit never applies. The root cause is in Ollama; the PR listed adds the field. The check reads the request any-llm sends, so the cell stays WRONG after Ollama's fix and re-recording does not change it: retire or rewrite the scenario when that release ships.

any-llm documents the fallback: a Gemini finish reason without an OpenAI counterpart (OTHER, LANGUAGE, MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL and any unfamiliar value) maps to None and a complete response then reports stop (https://github.com/mozilla-ai/any-llm/blob/18ed82b8ae89db560bf0b1ec8bccb752fc0e2b5d/src/any_llm/providers/gemini/utils.py#L572-L581). The caller cannot tell such a stop from a normal one.

any-llm's Gemini provider builds call_{hash(function_call.name)}_{n} ids (providers/gemini/utils.py, non-stream and stream converters) and never reads FunctionCall.id, which google-genai exposes and Gemini sends. The ids also differ between processes because str hash() is salted. Reproduced on 1.33.0 and on main at 18ed82b.

any-llm documents the fallback: Anthropic stop reasons without an OpenAI counterpart (stop_sequence, pause_turn) fall through to stop, and the lookup defaults to stop for any unfamiliar value (https://github.com/mozilla-ai/any-llm/blob/1.33.0/src/any_llm/providers/anthropic/utils.py#L40-L50, unchanged on main at 18ed82b). The caller cannot tell such a stop from a normal one.
